overview: This project focuses on migrating Halvard Mutual Insurance Group's 15-year-old on-premises policy administration system to Microsoft Azure. The initiative includes modernizing the platform, shortening the overnight batch window, and introducing a policyholder self-service portal, all within a phased migration approach.
business_problem: Halvard Mutual Insurance Group must migrate its legacy on-premises policy administration system to Azure before its data-centre lease expires in Q3 2028. The existing system, a Java monolith with Oracle 12c and numerous batch jobs, also presents challenges with long overnight batch windows and lacks modern self-service capabilities for policyholders.
